title: Cover and Extraction
author: Odile Dunmore
blurb: Freya Okafor, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
